description: proto8/schema 逐檔表（生成物，別手改）：tree 照資料夾巢狀，字串＝檔、物件＝夾，值＝那個檔檔頭的一句話；工具夾的 _entry／_tooldef.json／_metainfo.json 併成一格「名/」。要改說明去改檔頭，再跑 python3 wf/tools/index_gen.py --apply。

1.board.json: The board of one proc: <stack>/board.json (the user: ~/.aos/user/board.json). Readers ignore keys they do not know.
1.channel-members.json: <channel stack>/members.json, written only by the channel proc; key = member stack absolute path.
1.channel.json: <channel stack>/channel.json; a proc whose stack has this file is a channel.
1.letter-comm.json: Only body.comm of a letter; the rest of the body is not described here. No comm, a comm that is not an object, v above 1 or an unknown level = a norm…
